title: 71% Of Earth's Seafloor Is Still Unmapped
hook: Most ground beneath Earth's oceans is still invisible to modern maps.
closing: The largest unmapped landscape is not in space; it is beneath our oceans.
question: Would you explore sea or space?

segments.say: Modern seafloor mapping rose from 6 percent to 28.7 percent. Progress still leaves most of the bottom unseen.
Mars is 99.5 percent mapped, versus 28.7 percent of the ocean floor. Another planet is far more complete.
Unmapped ocean floor spans 257 million square kilometers. That is larger than the entire surface of Mars.
